description: Displays a playable French loto game.

attributes.name: cards
attributes.description: Number of loto tickets displayed, from 1 to 4.

methods.name: draw(): number | null
methods.description: Draws and returns the next number, or null when the game is over.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Generates a new ticket and resets the draw and chronometer.

events.name: tp-loto-draw
events.description: Emitted after a number is drawn.

events.name: tp-loto-reset
events.description: Emitted after a new ticket and draw are generated.

events.name: tp-loto-win
events.description: Emitted when every displayed ticket number has been drawn.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-chronometer
dependencies.summary: Chronometer component with play, pause and stop controls.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

dependencies.name: tp-switcher
dependencies.summary: Switches between horizontal and vertical layouts based on available space.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-loto>` element implements the <tp-icon name="loto" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Loto functionality: displays a playable French loto game.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Draw numbers using the game control and compare them with the tickets. |
| Using the component | The history shows numbers already drawn; the reset button starts a new game. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| Ctrl+? | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include Shift if needed to type ?. |
